items.title: Equinix (EQIX) Opens Sixth Singapore Data Center For AI With 100% Renewable Energy
items.summary: Equinix (NasdaqGS:EQIX) has opened its sixth Singapore facility, SG6, expanding its regional data center portfolio for AI workloads. The SG6 site is designed to support high-density compute and advanced liquid cooling to accommodate intensive AI and high-performance computing demands. Equinix reports that SG6 operates on 100% renewable energy and uses resource-efficient building materials to limit environmental impact. items.title: BMO Highlights Data Center Stocks as Development Risks Rise
items.summary: Investing.com -- BMO Capital Markets has identified the best-positioned data center stocks as recent election results in key states raise the risk of development delays and potential moratoriums. According to analysts Ari Klein and John P. Kim, uncertainty around future development has increased, though sub-1% vacancy rates and strong AI demand should support pricing for existing operators.
